title: How to Clone a Post Type
text:
## How to Clone a Post Type
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000036510
In some cases, the admin might want to have a duplicate a post type but with a different name and for a different purpose. Follow the steps in this article, to learn how to clone a post type.
In this example, the Events post type will be cloned in order to create an Open House post type.
Go to My Content >> Edit Post Settings
Find the post type to be cloned and hover over the Actions > Click on Clone
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185006019/original/ICc66GKLfJNuvuev3IzE3kaU3SUS0PNGTQ.png?1789067181 | alt: ]
Now, the new cloned post type will appear at the top, click on Edit:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185006065/original/22VqrUASa7MqjqvI3dINU9Y5vp-IrbgUEA.png?1789067240 | alt: ]
Edit the Name and URL  in these fields:
In this case, the cloned post type will be called "Open House"
Name: Open House
URL Permalink: open-house
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185006111/original/JmYVR3E5UzGmV4lpjOOsXhws98Cr-cLZHw.png?1789067289 | alt: ]
On the Profile Page Design tab, update the Profile Page Tab Title :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185006164/original/WXCSaXRYLQAQiZCaLhSogHTS_GTk03YPtQ.png?1789067384 | alt: ]
On the "Search Results Design" tab must also update the H1 that is going to display in your search results page.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185006176/original/PU8HlF1SapOSw3y-3v7wkpouvTMCq3ZwYQ.png?1789067393 | alt: ]
Finally, Click on Save Changes .

## Adding the new Post Type to Membership Plans
The last step is to add the new post type to each membership plan by going to Finance >> Membership Plans >> Post Publishing Tab >> Check the "Can Post"
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185006249/original/dFNIRR9w4TI4Mi1pFqTzC2NwY-iq-T8Whw.png?1789067459 | alt: ]
Now members subscribed to this membership plan will be able to post "Open Houses".
All new posts will be published in the link previously added for the post type.
Example: https://contentdocumentation.directoryup.com/open-house
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12185006456/original/zzbvIN-6iKVa9zUhbJV9XxFTzb3zpK-S_Q.png?1789067665 | alt: ]
